text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 2) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 26 April 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 26 April 2022 hingga 6 Mei 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging lembu tempatan (kecuali bahagian batang pinang)

2. Daging lembu import

3. Daging kerbau import (India)

4. Cili merah

5. Tomato

6. Timun

7. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

8. Kacang panjang

9. Terung panjang

10. Halia tua import

11. Ikan kembung termasuk ikan mabung (berat antara 8 ekor

hingga 12 ekor sekilogram)

12. Ikan selayang (berat antara 8 ekor hingga 12 ekor sekilogram)

13. Ikan aya atau tongkol (berat antara 1 ekor hingga 2 ekor sekilogram)

14. Ikan demuduk, sagai, cermin atau cupak

Dibuat 15 April 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 2) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No.2) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 26 April 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 26 April 2022 to 6 May 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local beef (not including tenderloin)

2. Imported beef

3. Imported buffalo meat (India)

4. Red chilli

5. Tomato

6. Cucumber

7. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

8. Long bean

9. Long eggplant

10. Imported old ginger

11. Indian mackerel (weight ranges between 8 fishes to 12 fishes

per kilogram)

12. Scad (weight ranges between 8 fishes to 12 fishes per kilogram)
